event_v0.doc: `harvest` supplied the asset the strategy held to K2.
event_v0.name: IdleReinvested

event_v0.doc: `harvest` claimed a reward. `claimed` is the reward that arrived and `proceeds` the asset\nit became (both measured by balance change); `vest_end` is when everything harvested so\nfar has vested.
event_v0.name: RewardHarvested

function_v0.doc: `[id_this, id_market(this, data), id_collateral(aToken)]` (Q109). `InvalidData` for\nanything but this strategy's router.
function_v0.name: ids

function_v0.doc: The strategy's books now. Never fails and never writes: with an index below the last\none seen or a read that fails, the parts read so far are 0.
function_v0.name: books

function_v0.doc:
Keeper only (Q108). With `data` (a `HarvestInstruction`), claims all of one reward
accrued on the aToken, swaps it to the asset when it is another token, and adds the
proceeds to the vest. Then, with at least `REINVEST_THRESHOLD` idle, supplies all of it.
The instruction is checked before any call (`InvalidData`); a claim or swap K2 or
Soroswap refuses is `ProtocolRejected` and reverts everything, so the reward stays
claimable. A supply K2 refuses leaves the asset idle and is not an error.
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc:
Supplies `assets`, pulled from the vault, to K2, and turns the reserve off as the
strategy's collateral so no exit reads an oracle price (Q107). Only the bound vault,
and only while the factory approves it (`VaultNotApproved` otherwise). `change` is the
position's value now minus the value last recorded. The protocol total grows by
`assets` (Q89), less what the principal stood above the value (Q90). K2's refusal
(paused, frozen, capped) is `ProtocolRejected`; an index below the last one seen is
`ProtocolRejected` before any call (V1's tripwire).
function_v0.name: allocate

function_v0.doc:
Pays exactly `assets` to the bound vault, from what the strategy holds first and the
rest withdrawn from K2 to the strategy (so K2's whitelist never gates the vault).
Never gated by approval or the protocol cap. `InsufficientPosition` above the
position's value, or for any other vault. A paused pool or reserve, or too little cash
at K2, is `InsufficientLiquidity`; `max_deallocate` reports both. The protocol total
loses the principal taken out (all of it on a full exit) and whatever of the rest
stands above the value (Q89, Q90).
function_v0.name: deallocate

function_v0.doc: The bound vault's position: NAV, rounded down. The value last recorded when the index\nis below the last one seen or a read fails; 0 for any other vault. Never fails and\nnever writes.
function_v0.name: real_assets

function_v0.doc:
Binds the instance to `vault` for good (Q106): no function changes it, and every other
vault is refused. `factory` decides whether `vault` may still allocate;
`cap_authority` alone sets the protocol cap; `keeper` alone may call `harvest`.
`router` is K2's router, which must list `asset` (its aToken and reserve id are read
here); `incentives` pays the reserve's emissions; `swap_router` is Soroswap's router.
`InvalidConfig` if the router does not answer for `asset`, or unless `vest_seconds` is
within `[MIN_VEST_SECONDS, MAX_VEST_SECONDS]`.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: lowers the vault's principal, and the protocol total by the same amount, to
the position's value when that is lower (a deficit at K2 lowers it), and emits
`PrincipalSynced`. Never raises it, moves no money and reports no `change`. Another
vault, an index below the last one seen, or a read that fails leaves things as they
are (Q90). `InvalidData` for a `data` that is not this strategy's router.
function_v0.name: sync_position

function_v0.doc:
What `deallocate(vault, data, x)` can pay now: the position's value, capped by idle
plus what K2 can pay (the aTokens' value and the cash the aToken holds). 0 while the
pool is paused or the reserve is inactive or paused, with the index below the last one
seen, on malformed `data`, for another vault or on any failed read (Q107). Never writes.
function_v0.name: max_deallocate

function_v0.doc: The vault's principal: put in and not taken out (Q89).
function_v0.name: total_allocated

function_v0.doc: Cap authority only. 0 removes the cap.
function_v0.name: set_protocol_cap
